import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Select relevant columns for the visualization
columns = ['Marital_Status', 'Income', 'MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'Response']

# Melt the dataframe to prepare it for the bar plot
customer_segments_melted = pd.melt(customer_segments, id_vars=['Marital_Status', 'Income'], value_vars=[col for col in customer_segments.columns if col in columns[2:]], var_name='Category', value_name='Spending')

# Group by Marital_Status and Income, and calculate the mean spending for each group
customer_segments_grouped = customer_segments_melted.groupby(['Marital_Status', 'Income', 'Category'])['Spending'].mean().reset_index()

# Pivot the grouped dataframe to prepare it for the heatmap
customer_segments_pivoted = customer_segments_grouped.pivot_table(index=['Marital_Status', 'Income'], columns='Category', values='Spending').reset_index()

# Create a heatmap of the mean spending for each group
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.heatmap(customer_segments_pivoted, annot=False, cmap='coolwarm', fmt='.2f', square=True)
plt.title('Mean Customer Spending by Marital Status, Income, and Category')
plt.xlabel('Category')
plt.ylabel('Marital Status - Income')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.yticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
